bundle.shortDescription: Unified auto-detecting & auto-downloading desktop suite for YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook
bundle.longDescription: Master Downloader converges FlowDL (YouTube), InstaFlow (Instagram), and FlowFB (Facebook) into one self-contained Windows desktop application powered by Tauri v2, Rust, yt-dlp, gallery-dl, Deno, and FFmpeg.
